clips.title: The story
paras: Galardell Valley is a rugged, dangerous canyon nestled in the northeastern heights of the Redridge Mountains. The gorge is overrun by aggressive gnoll packs and sits beneath the shadow of the infamous Tower of Ilgalar.

Carved into the northeastern cliffs of Redridge, Galardell Valley has fallen completely out of the control of Lakeshire's defenders. Fierce Redridge gnolls prowl the lowlands and camp along the canyon floor, organized under brutal pack leaders such as Lieutenant Fangore. Towering high above the ravines stands the dark spire of the Tower of Ilgalar, the stronghold of the renegade mage Morganth, making the entire valley a persistent source of dread for the surrounding settlements.
